name: Prehistoric Discovery
description: One evidence-led prehistoric survival discovery with a compact truthful hook.
composition_guidance: Show one clear prehistoric survival problem, practical object, or material trace with a readable human reaction. Keep people, place, and evidence materially connected.
required_elements: one dominant prehistoric survival subject or material trace
one short model-rendered factual discovery hook
avoid_elements: the full title, dense labels, fake archaeology, fantasy armor, modern objects, logos, watermarks, copied trade dress, and post-render overlays
headline_guidance: Write a truthful 2–5 word hook naming the real survival question, material trace, or adaptation. Never claim certainty beyond the evidence.
visual_style_guidance: Original simple 2D prehistoric educational cartoon with clear black outlines, flat limited colors, readable silhouettes, humble clothing and tools, and no photorealism or fantasy spectacle.
